entities.summary: Vasily Vasilievich Radlov, born Friedrich Wilhelm Radloff was a German and Russian linguist, ethnographer, and archaeologist, often considered to be the founder of Turkology, the scientific study of Turkic peoples. He was the first to publish the Orhon inscriptions.
